howTheTargetWasMet.explanation: Sixteen of the eighteen evidence-backed-but-thin pages failed exactly one criterion: they had zero typed links. Their families were generated by a branch reading `[...inputs, ...outputs].length > 0 ? [] : []`, which returns an empty list either way, so their related records were never emitted. Those pages already carried nine to twenty-two explanatory claims, three to eight limitations, a mechanism section and seven rendered dimensions, and already had inspected source support. Fixing the emission is a defect fix, not new evidence, and this report does not present it as new evidence.
howTheTargetWasMet.whyTwoRemain: The two neuromorphic comparison pages fail on direct-answer length, at 84 and 71 characters against a 120-character floor. Extending an answer purely to cross that floor is the padding this programme refuses, so they were left thin rather than lengthened.

defectsFixed.defect: Related records were discarded by a ternary returning an empty list in both branches.
defectsFixed.fix: Removed the dead branch and derived related records by co-citation.

defectsFixed.defect: Supplier pages linked to /knowledge/processes/process-<id>, which does not exist. Sixteen supplier pages carried broken links to production; the sitemap contains zero such routes.
defectsFixed.fix: An explicit correspondence table maps each declared process identifier to the process article slug. Seven of the eighteen entries were wrong on a first pass and were corrected against the real slug list before use.

defectsFixed.defect: The compiled shape recorded only a count of related routes, so a link to a nonexistent route could not be detected.
defectsFixed.fix: The routes themselves are now emitted and a test asserts each one resolves.

linkDerivation.rule: Two pages are related when they cite the same source. Derived from the compiled source lists, sorted for byte-identical regeneration.
linkDerivation.notUsed: No similarity or topical heuristic. A heuristic would let a page earn substantiality from a resemblance nobody checked.

boundary: Sixteen pages became substantial because a generator defect was fixed, not because new evidence was acquired. No page gained a source, a passage or a claim in this batch beyond the religion pilot.
